_source: posim/src/parser.rs (EBNF header + productions), posim/src/vm.rs HELP_TEXT, posim/src/qm.rs QM_SUBCOMMANDS

commands.name: NEW
commands.meaning: create one physical object; prints its handle objN

commands.name: SET
commands.meaning: write any field through the get/set API

commands.name: GET
commands.meaning: read any field — a PATH only, no arithmetic

commands.name: DEL
commands.meaning: delete object n; later objects renumber

commands.name: LIST
commands.meaning: one line per object

commands.name: STEP
commands.meaning: advance time by dt through SUNDIALS

commands.name: RUN
commands.meaning: advance by t with n evenly spaced output points (default 10)

commands.name: METHOD
commands.meaning: choose the SUNDIALS integrator

commands.name: ENERGY
commands.meaning: total energy: kinetic + softened pairwise gravity + uniform-field potentials

commands.name: COM
commands.meaning: system center of mass

commands.name: MOMENTUM
commands.meaning: total linear momentum

commands.name: ANGMOM
commands.meaning: total angular momentum about the origin (orbital + spin)

commands.name: LAPLACE
commands.meaning: Laplace-Runge-Lenz vector of object n about the system COM, k = G*M_total

commands.name: RESET
commands.meaning: wipe everything back to an empty system (NOT the same as SCENE RESET)

commands.name: HELP
commands.meaning: the quick-reference card

commands.name: SCENE
commands.meaning: the graphical scene window family

commands.name: COLLIDE
commands.meaning: switch rigid-body collision detection; bare reports status

commands.name: CONTACTS
commands.meaning: list every contact of the last STEP/RUN

commands.name: LET
commands.meaning: bind a session variable

commands.name: FUNCS
commands.meaning: list user function signatures

commands.name: SHOW
commands.meaning: print a user function's source verbatim

commands.name: BOX
commands.meaning: rigid, infinitely massive bounding box; bare reports status

commands.name: QM
commands.meaning: one-dimensional quantum mechanics

commands.name: QM2
commands.meaning: two-dimensional quantum mechanics, by ADI

commands.name: QM3
commands.meaning: three-dimensional quantum mechanics

commands.name: <expr>
commands.meaning: bare expression — the only way to do arithmetic on a field

commands.name: DEF
commands.meaning: LINE FORM, recognised before the grammar; every body line is syntax-checked at definition

commands.name: <call>
commands.meaning: call a user function; missing trailing arguments take their defaults

operators.note: comparisons sit at the LOWEST precedence and yield 1/0; there is no boolean type

cli_modes.meaning: batch; exits nonzero if any cell failed
load a file then STAY interactive (the dynamic-notebook launcher)
JSONL request/reply protocol (the JupyterLab kernel's transport)
